knownLimitations.detail: Skinned seven-segment meshes remain absent from static GLBs. The 24V discrete I/O bench supplies deterministic CanvasTexture overlays for timer-box.glb and counter-box.glb; servo and MPS displays remain pending.

runtimeOverlays.detail: Displays deterministic simulated timer PV, counter PV and counter preset values. It is a runtime teaching overlay, not extracted manufacturer geometry.
